method: Visual review of all 155 files in six contact sheets; selected 1000-pixel sRGB proxies inspected. No full-resolution texture measurement or controlled before/after render performed.
look_identification: Tentative from date-stamp colors matching CCDLook.swift: orange A7, red A8, pale blue C1, green N2. Not matched against device manifest.

findings.issue: Warm/olive skin cast in A7/A8; C1 selfie appears more neutral
findings.next: Compare identical archived input across looks before changing temperature or skin mapping globally.

findings.issue: Large colored solar highlight patch; shape and area vary by look
findings.next: Inspect original archived frame, then disable bloom, diffusion, halation, shoulder individually. Clipped sun disk alone is not a failure.

findings.issue: C1 appears crisper with deeper shadows; N2 appears softer/greener in daylight
findings.next: Inspect native-resolution flat shadow and edge crops before adjusting grain or denoising.

limits: No verified app build identification; cannot accept or reject latest code change from these files.
HEIC EXIF software identifies OS, not the PocketCCD build.
Sequential handheld photos differ in framing/exposure and are not controlled A/B inputs.
Screenshots and timestamp-named reference files excluded from PocketCCD conclusions.
No night/flash, temporal-white-balance or preview/capture parity acceptance from this daylight set.
additional_finding: A7/A8 saturation stage amplifies warm skin in archived shop originals; temperature-only ablation did not resolve it. Added warm-midtones saturation protection and a real-portrait ROI regression.
